accounts.signInHint: Sign in on Microsoft's own page — the launcher never sees your password.
accounts.empty: No accounts yet. Launches will use an offline session.
accounts.codeInstruction: Open {uri} in your browser and enter this code:
accounts.codeWaiting: Waiting for you to finish in the browser…
accounts.needClientId: Online sign-in needs a Microsoft application (client) ID approved for the Minecraft API. Register an Azure app (personal accounts, public client flows enabled), get it approved at aka.ms/mce-reviewappid, then paste the client ID into Settings → Accounts. See docs/ACCOUNTS.md for the full walkthrough. Until then, instances launch with an offline session and cannot join online servers.
page.accounts.text: Microsoft account sign-in arrives in Phase 3.
instances.empty: No instances yet. Create your first one above.
instances.noVersion: No Minecraft version available yet — check the Versions page.
versions.stale: You appear to be offline — showing the cached version list.
settings.title: Settings
settings.restartRequired: This change takes effect after the launcher restarts.
settings.saveError: The setting could not be saved: {error}
setting.launcher.language.name: Language
setting.launcher.language.description: Display language for the launcher interface.
setting.ui.theme.name: Theme
setting.ui.theme.description: Visual theme. Drop a theme folder into the data directory's themes folder and it appears here.
setting.ui.font_scale.name: Font scale
setting.ui.font_scale.description: Scales all launcher text, in percent (50–200).
setting.ui.reduced_motion.name: Reduced motion
setting.downloads.concurrency.name: Download concurrency
setting.downloads.concurrency.descriptio: How many files may download at the same time (1–16).
setting.downloads.retries.name: Download retries
setting.downloads.retries.description: How many times a failed download is retried before giving up (0–10).
setting.java.default_max_ram_mb.name: Default maximum RAM (MB)
setting.java.default_max_ram_mb.descript: Default -Xmx for new launches. 0 lets the launcher choose based on your system's RAM. Instances can override this.
setting.java.default_min_ram_mb.name: Default minimum RAM (MB)
setting.java.default_args.name: Default JVM arguments
setting.java.default_args.description: Applied to launches when an instance defines no arguments of its own. Wrong values here can stop the game from starting.
setting.accounts.client_id.name: Microsoft client ID
setting.accounts.client_id.description: The Azure application ID used for Microsoft sign-in. It must be approved by Mojang for the Minecraft API. Leave empty to launch with offline sessions only.
setting.advanced.log_level.name: Log level
setting.advanced.log_level.description: Verbosity of launcher logs. Debug and trace produce large files.
notice.configRecovered: {file} was unreadable and has been reset to defaults. A backup of the old file was saved to {backup}.
presets.startOptimized: Start optimized: Fabric + the Fabulously Optimized mod set + Faeries mods
presets.optimized.hint: The same 46 mods as Fabulously Optimized 14.1 — Sodium, Lithium, Iris, Continuity, Entity Texture Features, Zoomify, Controlify, Mod Menu, and the rest — plus BadOptimizations and the Faeries Theme (in-game icon, menu, loading screen) and Faeries Pack Vault mods. No gameplay changes.
presets.installing: Installing the optimized mod set… this downloads about 45 MB of mods.
presets.skipped: {count} had no build for this Minecraft version yet: {names}.
presets.removed: Removed {count} mod(s) the set no longer carries: {names}.
mods.noInstances: Create an instance first — mods belong to an instance.
mods.empty: No mods yet. Add jar files to this instance's mods folder, then use Import.
mods.imported: Imported {count} mod(s) into the active profile.
mods.untracked: This jar is not tracked in the mod store. Use Import to adopt it.
mods.loaderNone: This instance is vanilla — install a loader before adding mods.
mods.loaderInstalled: {kind} installed. It will be used on the next launch.
mods.loaderNotInstallable: Versions of {loader} are listed, but installing it is not supported yet — it requires running its official installer's processor pipeline. Fabric and Quilt work today.
home.card.noMods: No mods enabled for this instance.
home.card.name: Name
palette.title: Global search
palette.placeholder: Search settings, instances, mods, versions, actions…
palette.footer: ↑↓ to move · Enter to run · Esc to close
downloads.idle: Nothing is downloading. Activity appears here while the launcher installs a version or its mods.
setting.shortcuts.palette.name: Global search
setting.shortcuts.palette.description: Opens the search palette. Write accelerators like Ctrl+K or Ctrl+Shift+P.
setting.shortcuts.launch.name: Launch instance
setting.shortcuts.launch.description: Starts the first instance in the list.
setting.shortcuts.instances.name: Open instances
setting.shortcuts.mods.name: Open mods
setting.shortcuts.settings.name: Open settings
setting.shortcuts.refresh.name: Refresh versions
setup.welcome.title: Welcome to Faeries Launcher
setup.welcome.body: A few quick questions and you will be ready to play. You can change any of this later in Settings.
setup.system.title: What we found on your machine
setup.system.body: These are used for suggestions only — nothing is changed without you asking.
setup.system.noJava: None detected — the launcher will download one when needed.
setup.appearance.title: Pick a look
setup.appearance.body: Themes are folders you can edit or share. Drop new ones into the themes folder and they appear here.
setup.account.title: Sign in to Minecraft
setup.account.body: Signing in lets you join online servers. You can skip this and play singleplayer with an offline session.
setup.instance.title: Create your first instance
setup.instance.body: An instance is a self-contained Minecraft setup with its own mods, worlds, and settings.
setting.launcher.setup_complete.name: Setup completed
setting.launcher.setup_complete.descript: Whether the first-launch wizard has run. Turn this off to see it again.
layout.title: Layout
layout.body: Show, hide, and reorder parts of the interface. These are your own overrides — they sit on top of the theme and survive switching themes.
setting.ui.layout_overrides.name: Layout overrides
setting.ui.layout_overrides.description: Your interface layout, as JSON merged over the theme's. Edited by the Layout panel below.
perf.title: Performance
perf.body: Live process statistics. Sampling runs only while this page is open — close it and the launcher goes back to costing nothing while idle.
home.card.cosmeticsBody: No cosmetics system yet. Capes, wings, and particles would need a service to host them.
home.card.friendsBody: No friends list yet. This would need an account service with presence.
